title: Companies (Management and Administration) Amendment Rules, 2025 — G.S.R. 358(E)

content.publisher: Ministry of Corporate Affairs / Gazette of India
content.citation: Companies (Management and Administration) Amendment Rules, 2025, G.S.R. 358(E), 30 May 2025
content.note: The official Gazette identifier and full notification text were checked against indexed secondary reproductions, including the reproduced operative clauses: G.S.R. 358(E), dated 30 May 2025, brings the amendment into force on 14 July 2025 and substitutes Forms MGT-7, MGT-7A and MGT-15 in the Annexure to the Companies (Management and Administration) Rules, 2014. An official Rajya Sabha debate/laying record lists this exact notification among MCA notifications laid before the House: https://cms.rajyasabha.nic.in/UploadedFiles/Debates/OfficialDebatesDatewise/Floor/268/582025/05082025.pdf. The official Gazette PDF URL remains recorded at https://egazette.gov.in/WriteReadData/2025/263573.pdf, but that primary PDF was not independently retrieved here; therefore the operative wording is not marked primary-text verified. This is limited amendment-chain evidence only. The amendment is to Annexure forms, not Rule 18 on its face; it does not verify the full current Rule 18, prove the absence of later amendments, or replace checking the complete official Gazette text.
